it has target="_blank" and rel="noopener noreferrer"
the existing GitHub icon link still has aria-label "View the Pixie sandbox site source code on GitHub" and its SVG icon is present
the "Last updated" row and the BackToTop button behave exactly as they did before

assumptions.assumption: The Source link is placed before the existing GitHub icon link in the same flex row, separated by a space.
The existing GitHub icon link remains unchanged — the Source link is an addition, not a replacement.
No feature flag is needed for this change given its small scope.

clarified_description: Add a plain-text link labelled "Source" in the site footer, pointing to the GitHub repository https://github.com/pixie-sandbox/pixie-sandbox-site. The link is placed inline with the existing GitHub icon link in the same flex row, using matching styling. The existing GitHub icon link and all existing tests remain unchanged.

constraints.detail: The link must point to https://github.com/pixie-sandbox/pixie-sandbox-site — the same URL already used by the existing GitHub icon link in Footer.tsx line 26
The change must be limited to components/Footer.tsx and a new test in __tests__/Footer.test.tsx (or a new test file) — no new component files

deferred_decisions: aria-label text for the Source link — the spec suggests 'Source code on GitHub' but the exact wording is left to the engineer to decide based on what feels most natural alongside the existing 'View the Pixie sandbox site source code on GitHub' label
must: WHEN the Footer component renders the system shall include a link with visible text "Source" that points to https://github.com/pixie-sandbox/pixie-sandbox-site
The system shall open the Source link in a new tab (target="_blank") with rel="noopener noreferrer"
The Source link shall use the same styling classes as the existing GitHub link (font-medium text-zinc-950 dark:text-zinc-50 hover:underline)
The Source link shall be placed before the existing GitHub icon link in the same flex row
The system shall not modify the existing GitHub icon link, its aria-label, its SVG, or its test assertions
The system shall not alter the BackToTop component, the changelog data, or the "Last updated" row

non_functional.why_not: Adding one text link has no measurable performance impact
No personal data is collected or changed
No analytics or logging is involved

non_functional.target: Source link is keyboard-focusable and has an accessible name

non_functional.why_not: No regulatory requirements are affected by adding a footer link

outcome: Visitors can click a "Source" link in the footer to open the GitHub repository in a new tab.
rationale: The feature asks for a 'Source' link in the footer pointing to the GitHub repo. The footer already has a GitHub icon link to the same URL, so the change is additive. Placing the Source text link before the icon link keeps the flex row layout intact and gives screen-reader users a clear text anchor before the icon. Using the same styling classes ensures visual consistency without introducing new CSS. No new component is needed — an inline <a> element is sufficient. The existing tests for the GitHub link and BackToTop are preserved and must continue to pass.

risks.mitigation: The new Source link uses a different accessible name (/source/i), so getByRole('link', { name: /github/i }) continues to select only the existing GitHub link. Verify all existing tests still pass.
risks.title: Breaking existing test assertions that select the GitHub link by role/name

risks.mitigation: Using the same styling classes and adding only one short text link keeps the row width change minimal. Review at 375px width.
risks.title: Visual layout shift in the footer flex row

metrics: Zero test failures in Footer.test.tsx after the change

should: The Source link shall have an aria-label that is more descriptive than the visible text, e.g. "Source code on GitHub"
The Source link and the GitHub icon link shall be separated by a single space character for visual clarity
swe_constraints: Add the Source link as an inline <a> element inside the existing flex row (line 21–45 of Footer.tsx), before the existing GitHub icon link
Use the same styling classes as the existing GitHub link: font-medium text-zinc-950 dark:text-zinc-50 hover:underline
Add target="_blank" and rel="noopener noreferrer" on the Source link, matching the existing GitHub link
Do not modify the existing GitHub icon link, its aria-label, its SVG, or any existing test assertions
Do not create a new component file — the link is added inline in Footer.tsx
